update_uri.label: Custom Update Mirror
update_uri.help: Points to an internal mirror endpoint that must return GitHub-compatible latest-release JSON (at least containing tag_name). If assets are configured, CodeWhale requires the same asset set as the official release before prompting for an update.

locale.label: Web UI Language
locale.help: Select the display language for the Web UI.

default_text_model.label: Engine Default Model
default_text_model.help: Default text model used by the CodeWhale engine. Examples: deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash, etc. DeepSeek currently recommends deepseek-v4-pro.

update_check_for_updates.label: Check For Updates
update_check_for_updates.help: Checks for the latest stable version in the background. Shows a toast notification when a new version is available and resources are complete.

update_check_interval_hours.label: Update Check Interval
update_check_interval_hours.help: Cache interval for network update checks (hours). Set to 0 to check network on every startup. Failures are not cached.
